modSettingsTab.panelBridgeTip: PanelBridge 是執行在遊戲伺服器上的 Lua 模組,它讓本面板即時訪問沙盒選項、天氣、傳送和物品控制等功能。只有當它已安裝在伺服器上且伺服器正在執行時，模組設定才會載入。

PublicName.label: Server Name
PublicName.description: Your server name as shown to the public.

PublicDescription.label: Server Description
PublicDescription.description: The description that people can see while browsing your server.

Public.label: Public Server
Public.description: Can your server be seen on Steam server browser.

Open.label: Open (No Whitelist)
Open.description: Open to all players without requiring whitelist.

Password.label: Server Password
Password.description: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for no password.

PauseEmpty.label: Pause When Empty
PauseEmpty.description: The server will pause when no players are logged in.

ServerWelcomeMessage.label: Welcome Message
ServerWelcomeMessage.description: The welcome message displayed to players after connecting. Use <LINE> for new lines.

Map.label: Map
Map.description: The map you're playing on. Default is Muldraugh, KY.

SaveWorldEveryMinutes.label: Auto-Save Interval
SaveWorldEveryMinutes.description: Auto-save world every X minutes. 0 = never.

AnnounceDeath.label: Announce Deaths
AnnounceDeath.description: Server-wide announcement when a character dies.

AnnounceAnimalDeath.label: Announce Animal Deaths
AnnounceAnimalDeath.description: Display a global chat message when an animal dies.

Seed.label: World Seed
Seed.description: The worldgen seed used to generate the world. Changing this requires deleting map_worldgen.bin.

DefaultPort.label: Game Port
DefaultPort.description: The port players will use to connect to your server. Must be open on your router.

UPnP.label: Enable UPnP
UPnP.description: Enable UPnP for automatic port forwarding.

PingFrequency.label: Ping Frequency
PingFrequency.description: How often the server checks connection to players (seconds).

PingLimit.label: Ping Limit
PingLimit.description: Ping limit before being kicked (milliseconds). 100 to disable.

DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer.label: Deny Login When Overloaded
DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer.description: Prevent new connections when server is overloaded.

UseTCPForMapDownloads.label: Use TCP for Map Downloads
UseTCPForMapDownloads.description: Use TCP instead of UDP for map downloads.

MaxPacketsPerSecond.label: Max Packets Per Second
MaxPacketsPerSecond.description: Cap on packets per second sent to a connected client. Higher values increase bandwidth use; lower values may cause stutter under load.

UDPPort.label: UDP Port
UDPPort.description: Second port used for UDP connections.

LoginQueueEnabled.label: Login Queue
LoginQueueEnabled.description: Enable a login queue when the server is full.

LoginQueueConnectTimeout.label: Login Queue Timeout
LoginQueueConnectTimeout.description: Seconds before a queued connection times out.

server_browser_announced_ip.label: Announced IP
server_browser_announced_ip.description: IP address broadcast to the server browser. For multi-IP setups like server farms.

MultiplayerStatisticsPeriod.label: Statistics Period
MultiplayerStatisticsPeriod.description: Multiplayer statistics update period in seconds. 0 = disabled.

PVP.label: Enable PvP
PVP.description: Allow player vs player combat (each player can still toggle their own PvP).

SafetySystem.label: Safety System
SafetySystem.description: If PvP is enabled, allows players to toggle their own PvP on/off.

ShowSafety.label: Show Safety Status
ShowSafety.description: Show skull icon for players with safety off.

SafetyToggleTimer.label: Safety Toggle Timer
SafetyToggleTimer.description: Time in seconds to switch between PvP on and off.

SafetyCooldownTimer.label: Safety Cooldown Timer
SafetyCooldownTimer.description: Time in seconds before you can toggle safety again.

PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction.label: Melee While Hit Reaction
PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction.description: Allow melee attacks during hit reaction in PvP.

PlayerBumpPlayer.label: Player Collision
PlayerBumpPlayer.description: Players can bump into each other.

PVPLogToolChat.label: Log PvP to Chat
PVPLogToolChat.description: PvP events are logged to admin chat.

PVPLogToolFile.label: Log PvP to File
PVPLogToolFile.description: PvP events are logged to a file.

SafetyDisconnectDelay.label: Safety Disconnect Delay
SafetyDisconnectDelay.description: Seconds before PvP safety mode resets on disconnect.

ChatStreams.label: Chat Streams
ChatStreams.description: Enabled chat streams: s=say, r=radio, a=admin, w=whisper, y=yell, sh=safehouse, f=faction, all=global.

DisplayUserName.label: Display Usernames
DisplayUserName.description: Show player usernames above their heads and in chat.

ShowFirstAndLastName.label: Show Character Names
ShowFirstAndLastName.description: Display character first and last name instead of username.

MouseOverToSeeDisplayName.label: Mouse Over for Name
MouseOverToSeeDisplayName.description: Require mouse hover to see player names.

HidePlayersBehindYou.label: Hide Players Behind You
HidePlayersBehindYou.description: Hide player names for players behind your character.

BanKickGlobalSound.label: Ban/Kick Sound
BanKickGlobalSound.description: Play global sound when a player is banned or kicked.

UsernameDisguises.label: Username Disguises
UsernameDisguises.description: Allow players to disguise their username.

HideDisguisedUserName.label: Hide Disguised Names
HideDisguisedUserName.description: Hide the real username of disguised players.

ChatMessageSlowModeTime.label: Chat Slow Mode
ChatMessageSlowModeTime.description: Seconds between allowed chat messages per player.

MaxAccountsPerUser.label: Max Accounts Per User
MaxAccountsPerUser.description: Limit accounts per Steam user. 0 = unlimited.

DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.label: Remove From Whitelist On Death
DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.description: Remove player from whitelist if their character dies.

KickFastPlayers.label: Kick Speed Hackers
KickFastPlayers.description: Kick players moving faster than possible. May be buggy.

SpawnPoint.label: Spawn Point
SpawnPoint.description: Custom spawn point coordinates (X,Y,Z). 0,0,0 for default.

SpawnItems.label: Spawn Items
SpawnItems.description: Items new characters spawn with (comma-separated, e.g., Base.BaseballBat,Base.WaterBottleFull).

SleepNeeded.label: Sleep Required
SleepNeeded.description: Whether players need to sleep when exhausted.

PlayerRespawnWithOther.label: Respawn with Partner
PlayerRespawnWithOther.description: Enable spawning at splitscreen partner location.

PlayerSaveOnDamage.label: Save on Damage
PlayerSaveOnDamage.description: Save player state when they take damage.

Faction.label: Enable Factions
Faction.description: Allow creation and use of factions.

FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.label: Days to Create Faction
FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.description: Days a player must survive to create a faction.

FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.label: Players for Faction Tag
FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.description: Players required in faction to show tag.

AllowTradeUI.label: Allow Trading
AllowTradeUI.description: Allow players to directly trade with one another.

KnockedDownAllowed.label: Knocked Down
KnockedDownAllowed.description: Allow players to be knocked down. WIP: may cause visual desync.

SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers.label: Sneak Hides From Players
SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers.description: Players in sneak mode are hidden from other players.

MapRemotePlayerVisibility.label: Map Player Visibility
MapRemotePlayerVisibility.description: Who can see other players on the in-game map.

HideAdminsInPlayerList.label: Hide Admins in Player List
HideAdminsInPlayerList.description: Hide admin accounts from the player list.

SafehouseAllowTrepass.label: Allow Trespass
SafehouseAllowTrepass.description: Allow non-members to enter safehouses without invite.

SafehouseAllowLoot.label: Allow Looting
SafehouseAllowLoot.description: Allow non-members to take items from safehouses.

SafehouseAllowRespawn.label: Allow Safehouse Respawn
SafehouseAllowRespawn.description: Players can respawn in their safehouse.

SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.label: Days to Claim Safehouse
SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.description: Days a player must survive before claiming a safehouse.

SafeHouseRemovalTime.label: Safehouse Removal Time
SafeHouseRemovalTime.description: Real-time hours of inactivity before removal from safehouse.

DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected.label: Disable When Owner Online
DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected.description: Disable safehouse protection when the owner is connected. (Renamed from DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected in the Dec 2025 MP patch.)

SafehouseAllowNonResidential.label: Allow Non-Residential
SafehouseAllowNonResidential.description: Allow players to claim non-residential buildings as safehouses.

TrashDeleteAll.label: Delete All Trash
TrashDeleteAll.description: Delete all items when placed in trash.

RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval.label: Remove Player Corpses
RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval.description: Remove player corpses when corpse removal runs.

AllowDestructionBySledgehammer.label: Sledgehammer Destruction
AllowDestructionBySledgehammer.description: Allow players to destroy world objects with sledgehammer.

SafehousePreventsLootRespawn.label: Safehouse Blocks Loot Respawn
SafehousePreventsLootRespawn.description: Items will not respawn in buildings claimed as safehouses.

SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse.label: Sledgehammer Only in Safehouse
SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse.description: Restrict sledgehammer destruction to safehouses only. Requires Sledgehammer Destruction enabled.

WorkshopItems.label: Workshop Items
WorkshopItems.description: Steam Workshop item IDs to download (semicolon-separated).

DoLuaChecksum.label: Lua Checksum
DoLuaChecksum.description: Verify client Lua matches server. Must be disabled when using PanelBridge — the mod modifies server-side Lua files, which causes checksum mismatches and prevents players from connecting.

SteamScoreboard.label: Steam Scoreboard
SteamScoreboard.description: Show Steam usernames and avatars. true/false/admin.

SteamVAC.label: VAC Ban Check
SteamVAC.description: Check if connecting players have VAC bans.

DiscordChatChannel.label: Discord Chat Channel
DiscordChatChannel.description: The Discord channel name for game chat.

DiscordLogChannel.label: Discord Log Channel
DiscordLogChannel.description: The Discord channel name for server logs.

DiscordCommandChannel.label: Discord Command Channel
DiscordCommandChannel.description: The Discord channel name for commands.

WebhookAddress.label: Webhook URL
WebhookAddress.description: Slack/Discord incoming webhook URL for notifications.

ResetID.label: Reset ID
ResetID.description: Removing this resets zombies and loot (not time).

ServerPlayerID.label: Server Player ID
ServerPlayerID.description: Identifies if character is from another server.

CarEngineAttractionModifier.label: Car Engine Attraction
CarEngineAttractionModifier.description: Modifier for zombie attraction to car engines.

ZombieUpdateMaxHighPriority.label: Zombie High Priority Updates
ZombieUpdateMaxHighPriority.description: Max high priority zombie updates per tick.

SwitchZombiesOwnershipEachUpdate.label: Switch Zombie Ownership
SwitchZombiesOwnershipEachUpdate.description: Switch zombie ownership between players each update tick.

UltraSpeedDoesnotAffectToAnimals.label: Ultra Speed Ignores Animals
UltraSpeedDoesnotAffectToAnimals.description: Ultra speed mode does not affect animal simulation.

War.label: Enable Faction War
War.description: Enable faction war system. (Disabled by default since the Dec 2025 MP patch.)

WarStartDelay.label: War Start Delay
WarStartDelay.description: Seconds before war starts after being declared.

WarSafehouseHitPoints.label: War Safehouse Hit Points
WarSafehouseHitPoints.description: Safehouse hit points during faction war.

DisableRadioStaff.label: Disable Radio for Staff
DisableRadioStaff.description: Disable radio transmissions from staff access level.

DisableRadioAdmin.label: Disable Radio for Admins
DisableRadioAdmin.description: Disable radio transmissions from admin access level.

DisableRadioGM.label: Disable Radio for GMs
DisableRadioGM.description: Disable radio transmissions from GM access level.

DisableRadioOverseer.label: Disable Radio for Overseers
DisableRadioOverseer.description: Disable radio transmissions from overseer access level.

DisableRadioModerator.label: Disable Radio for Moderators
DisableRadioModerator.description: Disable radio transmissions from moderator access level.

DisableRadioInvisible.label: Disable Radio for Invisible
DisableRadioInvisible.description: Disable radio transmissions from invisible players.

BackupsCount.label: Backup Count
BackupsCount.description: Number of backup copies to keep.

BackupsOnStart.label: Backup on Start
BackupsOnStart.description: Create a backup when the server starts.

BackupsOnVersionChange.label: Backup on Version Change
BackupsOnVersionChange.description: Create a backup when the game version changes.

BadWordListFile.label: Bad Word List File
BadWordListFile.description: Path to file with prohibited words, one per line.

GoodWordListFile.label: Good Word List File
GoodWordListFile.description: Path to file with allowed words that may contain bad words, one per line.

BadWordPolicy.label: Bad Word Policy
BadWordPolicy.description: Action taken when a bad word is detected in chat.

BadWordReplacement.label: Bad Word Replacement
BadWordReplacement.description: Text that replaces bad words in chat.

AntiCheatSafety.label: Safety
AntiCheatSafety.description: Anti-cheat protection for the safety system.

AntiCheatNoClip.label: No Clip
AntiCheatNoClip.description: Anti-cheat protection against moving through solid objects.

AntiCheatPacketException.label: Packet Exceptions
AntiCheatPacketException.description: Anti-cheat protection for invalid network packets.

ClientCommandFilter.label: Command Log Filter
ClientCommandFilter.description: Semicolon-separated list of commands to exclude from cmd.txt log. Use -vehicle.* to exclude all vehicle, +vehicle.installPart to include specific.

ClientActionLogs.label: Client Action Logs
ClientActionLogs.description: Semicolon-separated list of actions written to ClientActionLogs.txt.

PerkLogs.label: Perk Level Logging
PerkLogs.description: Track changes in player perk levels in PerkLog.txt.

StartYear.label: Start Year
StartYear.description: Which year the game starts in.

StartMonth.label: Start Month
StartMonth.description: Which month the game starts in (1=Jan, 12=Dec).

StartDay.label: Start Day
StartDay.description: Which day of the month the game starts on.

StartTime.label: Start Time
StartTime.description: What time of day the game starts.

Zombies.label: Zombie Count
Zombies.description: Initial zombie population level. Also sets Population Multiplier in Advanced Zombie Options.

Distribution.label: Distribution
Distribution.description: How zombies are distributed across the map.

ZombieRespawn.label: Zombie Respawn
ZombieRespawn.description: How frequently new zombies are added to the world.

ZombieMigrate.label: Zombie Migration
ZombieMigrate.description: Zombies can migrate to empty cells.
